name: Arti et Amicitiae, Rokin 112
surveyedSource: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012165109 ring (RD, PDOK BAG WFS, CC0) in native east/south metres above the 3DBAG ground 0.60 m NAP (scripts/landmarks/arti-et-amicitiae-footprints.json, written by venue-prepare.ts). The pand is the whole block from the Rokin to the Kalverstraat/Spui corner: the Rokin block, its Spui end and the hall's Spui wall are drawn from rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0, venue-face-crops.ts at 50 px/m: TMX7316010203-002857_pano_0002_000077 and recording_2025-06-16_06-42-40_01729 for the Rokin, TMX7316060226-000019_pano_0000_003548 and TMX7316010203-001050_pano_0001_000027 for the Spui); the hall roof and the houses at the Kalverstraat corner keep the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0). Per wall in scripts/landmarks/arti-et-amicitiae-inventory.json.

attribution.title: Arti et Amicitiae, Rokin 112 at the Spui, Amsterdam: the artists' society's building (society founded 1839; white neo-classical front over two merged buildings)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with 3DBAG LoD2.2 heights and the 3DBAG shell for the hall roof and the Kalverstraat-corner houses (CC BY 4.0): the cream Rokin front with its rusticated ground floor, wreath medallions, pedimented and hooded first-floor windows, four bronze figures on consoles, oculus frieze, modillion cornice and the middle pediment with the society's arms; the blind rusticated Spui end with its attic panels and pedimented gable; the hall's Spui wall with shop windows. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
